trace.why: Mafia Maps stick map (black survey lines, no walls) at about 3.2 m/px, traced as lines. Only the darkest ink is taken (inkLevel 92: the grey labels, leaders and the blue-grey sea labels are lighter), plus the blue cenote dots (lineColours blue, minBlueExcess 18) so that lines running through a cenote stay continuous; pools that sit beside a line (Luz, La Mesa) and the Labyrinth mark are erased. Leader removal is off (leaderMaxPx 1): the leaders are lighter than the ink level anyway, and it took the Black Hole line. The lines past the yellow coastline are the passages to the three sea exits, kept. Separate lines (Jaguar, the Sickman and El Tucan branches, the line N of Cenote Air) stay separate: jumps. The Black Hole line touches the Blind Wall loop through a 1-px antialiased pixel and is kept joined.

symbols.why: Mafia Maps line plot: green overlined numbers are depths in feet, 'p N FT' penetrations; no letter codes, no legend, no bones. One dotted water-flow arrow (south-east). The low resolution (1001 px) defeats OCR: every symbol is listed by hand. The blue triangles past the coastline are the cave's exits to the sea, kept as leads-to.

placementWhy: Good (about 10-20 m): free similarity fit on four ground features, residuals 10, 10, 1 and 1 m, leave-one-out 19, 19, 2 and 4 m; 3.227 m/px and 2.4 degrees. The printed 1500 ft scale bar (2.80 m/px) is 15% short: at the fitted scale the traced plan length is 17.3 km against the 62,333 ft (19.0 km) surveyed, at the bar's scale only 15.0 km. Points: Mangrove Cenote on the black mangrove pool W of the beach road (the database's diveseven Mangrove is on it); Cenote Zapata (Tarpon) on the hotel cenote OSM names Cenote Tuuch, at the map's distance and bearing from Mangrove; La Mesa on the only open pond along its lines; Luz on the pond E of the Los Canales lagoon (fitted on the other three alone, Luz falls 4 m from it). Checks: the map's coastline lies on the real beach along the three exits (it drifts offshore further N, where it is schematic); the database's Del Mar (diveseven) is 31 m away. The GEO 1999 Ox Bel Ha map, as placed (ox-bel-ha-geo-1999), puts this area about 90-130 m too far E (its beach also lies about 70 m offshore): its points here are listed as checks only.
